heading: Freshly Made, Potent, Customized For You.
body: A prescription topical formula with up to 6 actives, designed to address women's hair loss.
activeIngredientsLabel: Topical Actives: Spironolactone, Finasteride, Minoxidil, Tretinoin, Fluocinolone, Biotin

ingredients.name: Spironolactone 1%
ingredients.body: Anti-androgen that may block DHT receptors at the hair follicle.*

ingredients.name: Finasteride 0.25%
ingredients.body: Topical DHT blocker intended for localized 5-alpha reductase inhibition.*

ingredients.name: Minoxidil 0–7.5%
ingredients.body: Vasodilator that may increase blood flow and nutrient delivery to hair follicles.*

ingredients.name: Tretinoin + Biotin
ingredients.body: Retinoid enhancer and B-vitamin that may support follicle absorption and hair shaft strength.*

ingredients.name: Fluocinolone (optional)
ingredients.body: May help calm scalp irritation and clear build up.*

safety.title: Common side effects
safety.body: Itching, burning, redness, flaking, dryness, scaling, peeling, stinging, changes in hair color or texture, irritation at the application site, and increased sun sensitivity.

safety.title: Tell your healthcare provider
safety.body: Share any history of scalp conditions, allergies to topical medications, current prescriptions, pregnancy or breastfeeding status, and any history of low blood pressure or fainting.

safety.title: Do not use if
safety.body: You are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding. Finasteride-containing medications carry risk of fetal harm and must be avoided in those scenarios.

safety.title: Seek medical care
safety.body: Severe scalp swelling, persistent rash, unexpected facial swelling, chest pain, fainting, or signs of an allergic reaction.
